dedupe_keys.name: usgs compilation of cost estimates for dam removal projects in the united states

description: This USGS data release compiles cost estimates for 668 dam removal projects in the United States listed in the USGS Dam Removal Information Portal. Costs were found in technical reports, books, newspapers, web pages and presentations, or by contacting project staff, and converted to 2020 dollars with the RS Means construction inflation index; totals can include planning, deconstruction and mitigation such as sediment removal, water diversions, treatment plants, revegetation and bank stabilisation. Each project also records the dam's purpose, size, construction material and reason for removal, its river and NHDPlus V2.1 watershed attributes, and the presence of 32 categories of cost drivers. The Western Fisheries Research Center published it on ScienceBase as a CSV with a JSON citation file, a PDF of source evidence and a Zotero library, as a free public-domain release. Caveats: the accuracy of the estimates is unknown, most represent total or minimum cost, and coverage is limited to removals with findable costs. Simulation uses: costing decommissioning options in capacity planning and optimisation of ageing dam portfolios. Related record: the US National Inventory of Dams (data-usace-national-inventory-of-dams).
